CVE-2026-131920.title: In OpenStack Cinder before 29.1.1, by making an os-initialize_con ...
CVE-2026-131920.description: In OpenStack Cinder before 29.1.1, by making an os-initialize_connection request with an IQN that includes a path traversal as part of the connector's initiator element, an authenticated user with a 'member' role may create or overwrite files in the volume host filesystem. Only cinder-volume hosts using the LIO iSCSI target driver are affected. This target driver is typically used with the LVM volume driver.

CVE-2026-133189.title: A command injection vulnerability was found in OpenStack Cinder's ...
CVE-2026-133189.description: A command injection vulnerability was found in OpenStack Cinder's SSH-based storage-driver support. Incomplete validation of shell metacharacters allows an authenticated user who owns a volume on an affected backend to supply crafted connection information and inject additional commands into the storage array's management interface. Commands execute with the privileges of Cinder's configured backend account. This can disclose storage configuration information and, where that account has administrative permissions, could allow changes that affect the integrity or availability of other tenants' storage.

CVE-2026-93856.title: In OpenStack Cinder through 29.0.0, cross-project information dis ...
CVE-2026-93856.description: In OpenStack Cinder through 29.0.0, cross-project information disclosure can occur in the Messages API. A non-admin user with the project-scoped 'member' or 'reader' role making the Block Storage API v3.3 "List messages" call finds the non-expired user messages for other projects included in the response, resulting in the leakage of UUIDs of resources owned by other projects, in addition to the user message about the other projects' resources (which, by design, are sanitized generic messages). All Cinder deployments are affected.
